Judo vs. Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu: Cousins on the Mat

September 2, 2026 · Cristyan BJJ Academy, Hyannis MA

Judo and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu share a common ancestor, and they still complement each other today.

Shared roots

BJJ developed from judo techniques taught in Brazil in the early 20th century.

Judo's focus

Judo emphasizes throws and takedowns, with matches often won by a clean throw.

BJJ's focus

BJJ emphasizes ground control and submissions, with plenty of time spent on the mat.

Better together

Judo gives BJJ players reliable takedowns and balance. BJJ gives judo players confidence on the ground.
